C2, reward-zero defect found and fixed: T11 listed PAYMENTS_ADMIN_PASSWORD among the values that must never appear in a browser download. Its value is Kill Bill's upstream `password`, which every login form carries as a field type. A correct app would have failed. C2, reward-zero defect found and fixed: T01 and T14 read /proc/net/tcp for port 4173. Under environment_mode = separate the grader runs in its own container, so that is the verifier's own network namespace and 4173 is never listening there. Both now assert the pages and /api answer from APP_PUBLIC_URL's origin.

C2, destructive defect found and fixed: T48 posted a purchase as member2@example.com to probe validation the brief never pins. A lenient app would have written tempo-plus-kit permanently, breaking the no-licence assertions in T50 and T51 for every later run. The refused-purchase check now uses a fresh member's key conflict.
